Title: Public preview: Azure SignalR Service Premium Tier

Body.Content:
Azure SignalR Service Premium Tier provides key capabilities to enable important enterprise scenarios. This includes:

  • Adding resiliency to your SignalR Service instances through Azure availability zone support
  • Ensuring high availability using SignalR Service’s disaster recovery functionality
  • Easily scale up and down to meet capacity needs and optimize resource usage with autoscale
